en.copy:
Header:
"HARVEST FESTIVAL"
"Claim daily"
Block 1:
"FREE COIN & DAILY TASKS"
"1 free coin daily"
"6 tasks without a purchase:"
"1,300 pass points + 30 baskets"
Block 2:
"PATROL & START BONUS"
"NORMAL"
"1 die · 1–6 steps"
"1 coin"
"DOUBLE"
"2 dice · 2–12 steps"
"1 coin + 60 diamonds"
"Reach or pass start: rewards + tile EXP from 2–4 random tiles."
"Double patrol allows more start bonuses and faster tile upgrades."
"No automatic 2× total rewards."
"10 security per regular landing. Unused security carries over."
Block 3:
"HARVEST MARKET · DAILY"
"60 tickets → 10 golden universal shards"
"100 tickets → Deluxe Chest"
"choose 5,000 Refined Stones"
"Budget only tickets you already own."
Block 4:
"CORNUCOPIA · BOTH CONDITIONS"
"10 baskets = 1 abundance point"
"600 baskets in total = 60 personal points"
"+ Server milestone reached → final milestone reward"
"Includes 10 golden universal shards, among other rewards."
Footer:
"CHECK TIMERS"
"Pass, cornucopia and awards end before patrol and market."
en.prompt:
Use case: text-localization, precise image edit.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the German labelled Harvest Festival infographic for the DIE alliance.
Create the British English version by replacing EVERY German text label with the exact localized copy below. Keep "DIE" as the unchanged alliance brand.
Preserve the exact navy-and-aged-gold fantasy strategy-room design, dragon crest, all icons, four panels plus footer, 2:3 portrait framing and all numerical relationships. Adjust line wrapping and font size carefully so that longer text fits cleanly without clipping or omissions. Keep body lettering as large and readable as possible, matching the reference. Keep the translation faithful; do not add or remove mechanics or invent labels.
The only permitted remaining Latin brand text in Russian is "DIE" and the product name "Deluxe"; all other language text in the Russian version must be Cyrillic as provided.
In English keep the exact thousands commas; in French/Russian use the provided spaces; in Portuguese use the provided thousands periods.
All copy is mandatory, including BOTH the 600-basket personal requirement AND the server-milestone condition, the choice of 5,000 refined stones, and the lack of an automatic 2× total reward multiplier. Double patrol must cost ONE coin plus 60 diamonds and show TWO dice. Regular patrol must cost ONE coin and show ONE die.
No German words or mistranslated resource names. No transparent background.
Maintain high resolution; desired output 2048x3072.

fr.copy:
Header:
"FÊTE DES RÉCOLTES"
"Récupérer chaque jour"
Block 1:
"GRATUIT & MISSIONS DU JOUR"
"1 pièce gratuite par jour"
"6 missions sans achat :"
"1 300 points de pass + 30 paniers"
Block 2:
"PATROUILLE & BONUS DE DÉPART"
"NORMALE"
"1 dé · 1–6 cases"
"1 pièce"
"DOUBLE"
"2 dés · 2–12 cases"
"1 pièce + 60 diamants"
"Départ atteint ou dépassé : gains + EXP de 2–4 cases aléatoires."
"La double patrouille permet plus de bonus de départ et une amélioration plus rapide des cases."
"Le total des gains ne double pas automatiquement."
"10 points de sécurité par arrivée normale. Solde conservé."
Block 3:
"MARCHÉ DES RÉCOLTES · CHAQUE JOUR"
"60 tickets → 10 fragments universels dorés"
"100 tickets → coffre Deluxe"
"au choix : 5 000 pierres raffinées"
"Ne comptez que les tickets déjà acquis."
Block 4:
"CORNE D’ABONDANCE · DEUX CONDITIONS"
"10 paniers = 1 point d’abondance"
"600 paniers au total = 60 points personnels"
"+ Palier du serveur atteint → dernière récompense de palier"
"Comprend notamment 10 fragments universels dorés."
Footer:
"VÉRIFIER LES DURÉES"
"Pass, corne d’abondance et distinctions finissent avant patrouille et marché."

ru.copy:
Header:
"ПРАЗДНИК УРОЖАЯ"
"Забираем ежедневно"
Block 1:
"БЕСПЛАТНОЕ И ЕЖЕДНЕВНЫЕ ЗАДАНИЯ"
"1 бесплатная монета в день"
"6 заданий без покупки:"
"1 300 очков пропуска + 30 корзин"
Block 2:
"ПАТРУЛЬ И СТАРТОВЫЙ БОНУС"
"ОБЫЧНЫЙ"
"1 кубик · 1–6 шагов"
"1 монета"
"ДВОЙНОЙ"
"2 кубика · 2–12 шагов"
"1 монета + 60 алмазов"
"При достижении или прохождении старта: награды + опыт 2–4 случайных клеток."
"Двойной патруль позволяет чаще получать стартовые бонусы и быстрее улучшать клетки."
"Общий доход не удваивается автоматически."
"10 очков безопасности за обычное приземление. Остаток сохраняется."
Block 3:
"РЫНОК УРОЖАЯ · КАЖДЫЙ ДЕНЬ"
"60 билетов → 10 золотых универсальных осколков"
"100 билетов → сундук Deluxe"
"можно выбрать 5 000 очищенных камней"
"Планируйте только имеющиеся билеты."
Block 4:
"РОГ ИЗОБИЛИЯ · ОБА УСЛОВИЯ"
"10 корзин = 1 очко изобилия"
"600 корзин всего = 60 личных очков"
"+ Этап сервера достигнут → последняя награда этапа"
"Содержит в том числе 10 золотых универсальных осколков."
Footer:
"ПРОВЕРЯЙТЕ ТАЙМЕРЫ"
"Пропуск, рог изобилия и награды заканчиваются раньше патруля и рынка."

pt.copy:
Header:
"FESTIVAL DA COLHEITA"
"Resgate todo dia"
Block 1:
"GRÁTIS E MISSÕES DIÁRIAS"
"1 moeda grátis por dia"
"6 missões sem compra:"
"1.300 pontos de passe + 30 cestas"
Block 2:
"PATRULHA E BÔNUS DE INÍCIO"
"NORMAL"
"1 dado · 1–6 passos"
"1 moeda"
"DUPLA"
"2 dados · 2–12 passos"
"1 moeda + 60 diamantes"
"Ao alcançar ou passar pelo início: prêmios + EXP de 2–4 casas aleatórias."
"A patrulha dupla permite mais bônus de início e evolução mais rápida das casas."
"O total não dobra automaticamente."
"10 de segurança por chegada normal. O saldo é mantido."
Block 3:
"MERCADO DA COLHEITA · DIÁRIO"
"60 bilhetes → 10 fragmentos universais dourados"
"100 bilhetes → Baú Deluxe"
"opção: 5.000 Pedras Refinadas"
"Planeje só os bilhetes que já tem."
Block 4:
"CORNUCÓPIA · DUAS CONDIÇÕES"
"10 cestas = 1 ponto de fartura"
"600 cestas no total = 60 pontos pessoais"
"+ Etapa do servidor atingida → última recompensa de etapa"
"Inclui 10 fragmentos universais dourados, entre outros prêmios."
Footer:
"CONFIRA OS PRAZOS"
"Passe, cornucópia e condecorações acabam antes da patrulha e do mercado."
